ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio; approximately 65% high-intensity white pixels distributed across the lobe surfaces against 35% low-intensity black pixels concentrated at the central notch area, outer margins, and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white pixel regions occupy the majority of both lateral lobes. The central peduncle connection and median notch area are solid low-intensity black. The left lobe contains a distinct crossed linear black marking and several irregular spots. The right lobe contains multiple circular outlines and dark splotches toward the distal end.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression dividing the lobes with a calculated internal angle of approximately 82 degrees; apex is clearly defined.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the entire trailing margin. Left lobe exhibits high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged peaks. Right lobe exhibits larger, non-uniform notches and undulating peaks, particularly near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical broad convex curves extending from the center, tapering into slight upward concavities at the extreme lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple annular/circular low-intensity outlines detected on the white surface of the right lobe. Small clusters of high-intensity white pixels (likely barnacle colonization) are visible on the far-left and far-right black tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent crossed linear black marks ('X' shape) on the left lobe white field. Several horizontal and curvilinear dark markings are distributed across the ventral white areas of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe proximal to the median notch. Extensive edge erosion and irregular pigmentation present along the trailing margins of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique high-contrast 'X' or 'cross' shaped pigmentation mark located in the lower-central region of the left lobe's white field.
